flows.title: Find an agent and put it to work
steps: Start in the Microsoft Copilot app. Agents are available in both the Web and Work tabs.
In the navigation panel, find Agents and expand the chevron for the pre-installed ones, or select All agents to see everything in the Agent Store.
Select an agent. From the Agent Store, choose Add or Open.
Select one of its prompts, or type your question into the Message Copilot box.

flows.title: Share a link to an agent
steps: Start in the Microsoft Copilot app and look for the agent you want to share.
If it is listed under Agents in the left pane, hover over it and select More (…), then Share. The link is copied for you.
If it is not listed, select All Agents in the left pane, find the agent, hover over it, select More (…), then Share.
